blocks.text: Lakeshore inventory API REST design

This is the working cut for LSH-TDD-2022-022 on November 3, 2022. Greta Holm asked for a written bound after the current path (No API, Woo admin for stock) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host inv-api.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on integer storeId, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Node on inv-api.lakeshore.internal. storeId CHAR(2). Cursor on sku. Timeout 30s. Replica lag over 180s is 503. I am not restating a hallway yes. integer storeId is out because POS emits 3 and 03. Integer collapse is how Fort-Wayne-shaped joins died on a sibling job. CHAR(2). Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at timeout=30, lag=180, stores=4, sku=18.4k, p95=0.42, weeks=6, nodes=2, char=2. Sibling tickets LSH-4401 and LSH-REQ-2022-014. I will not reopen integer storeId in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
